title: Understanding Inertia and Distortion
text: Inertia is the sum of squared distances from each point to its assigned cluster center. Distortion is the average of these squared distances. Consider how these definitions relate to each other.

title: Calculating Inertia and Distortion
text: If you have a dataset with $$n$$ points, and you calculate the sum of squared distances to the cluster centers as S, what would be the distortion?

title: Relating Inertia and Distortion
text: Think about how inertia and distortion are related through the number of points, $$n$$. If inertia is the total sum of squared distances, how does it compare to distortion, which is the average?

title: True or False: Inertia Equals $$n$$ Times Distortion
text: Based on the relationship between inertia and distortion, is it true that inertia equals $$n$$ times distortion?
